result.title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
result.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld
result.summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

AI.brief_summary: ColonoWorld 是结肠镜世界模型，以相机轨迹与粗 3D 结肠管为条件、在活体视频上训练，可生成从盲肠到直肠的完整检查过程，并在指定位置与时间放入息肉、器械和冲洗。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按指令运动+解剖结构保持一致+可控放置病灶」的生成设定，可能为构造可干预的视觉证据环境、评估主动观察与证据使用提供线索，但本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，关系需核查。
